entries.7f9234e400ec6fc7: A distinguishing feature is an approach that places the highest importance on customer contact at service sites, using equipment and environmental diagnosis and assessment and solution proposals (energy-saving and cost-saving proposals, environmental improvement proposals) to uncover customers' latent needs. The company operates in an environment where interest is high in advanced technical capabilities, such as sterilization of operating rooms and prevention of hospital-acquired infections, and validation support at pharmaceutical plants and regenerative medicine research laboratories. The Technology and Training Center, which has training facilities that reproduce maintenance sites such as cleanrooms and machine rooms, is positioned as a strategic base, and the company seeks to raise added value through improving employees' skills.

entries.c9c91150ca8937a3: To achieve its long-term vision of 'Improving the happiness of all stakeholders sustainably,' the company has newly formulated the '2026 Medium-Term Four-Year Management Plan,' with the fiscal year ending March 2030 as its final year. The policy is to contribute to the sustainability of customers' business activities by focusing on strengthening the competitive advantage of its core business, accelerating the enhancement of human capital value to provide high-quality services at appropriate prices, strengthening approaches to manufacturing plants through solar power generation, deepening development of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities through validation support, opening new business with pharmaceutical and medical facilities through a new space decontamination method, and expanding and strengthening overseas operations. The plan's numerical targets concern future matters and are not transcribed here.
